spec.splits: the existing fresh five-fold split (seed 42), unchanged

selection.policy: identical to preregistration_fresh.yaml (validation-only, v1 tie rules)
selection.thresholds: v1 C6 rule, pooled validation rows, 0.005 macro / 0.01 per-domain vs S*

analysis.metric: nDCG@10, equal-weight macro over the four domains
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over B1-B4 at family-wise alpha 0.05 (one-sided bootstrap p-values)

hypothesis_tests.B1_h_star_superior_to_r_star: with an encoder stronger than BM25, FAISS candidates outside the BM25 top-100 matter (dev: H* - R* = +0.029)
hypothesis_tests.B2_p_star_superior_to_bm25: static bge proxy re-ranking improves BM25 (dev +0.011)
hypothesis_tests.B3_pe_gh_v1_noninferior_to_s_star: PE-GH v1 (bge) non-inferior to S*, margin 0.01
hypothesis_tests.B4_pe_gh_v1_beats_random_matched: v1_ridge beats 30-seed random routing at its own per-fold dense counts (dev +0.014)

secondary_reported_without_claims: dense ratio of PE-GH v1 at its operating point (dev 87%)
BM25-margin and LiteGator-style SVM at matched budget; AUC/Spearman of gate scores
cascade mode is reported descriptively only; on dev it falls back to R* in every fold
spec.negative_results_policy: every hypothesis is reported whatever the outcome; no threshold, alpha grid, feature or model change after the fresh bge-small rankings are scored
